name: Bahamas Business Solutions Limited
brand_truth: The Bahamas' Xerox company since 1966, with a Freeport office since 1968: sixty years of keeping island offices printing.

design.signature: Hero headline printed on a sheet that feeds out of a printer slot on load, with a scan line passing over it

current_site_findings: bbsl.com homepage carries a noindex, nofollow tag (tells Google not to list it).
Leftover 'has been added to the cart' message on the homepage.
No street address for Freeport (or Nassau) on the homepage.
Vendor logos have empty alt text.
The 1966 Xerox (Bahamas) heritage and 1968 Freeport office are not on the homepage.
pitch_line: Your website is telling Google not to list you; this version puts sixty years of BBSL, and both offices, in front of every office manager searching for a copier.
notes: Record said 'no own site' but BBSL runs bbsl.com (WordPress, uploads dated 2026). Headquartered in Nassau (90 Collins Avenue); the Freeport office has a phone but no published street address. VERIFY the noindex finding in a browser (view source) before pitching; it came from a WebFetch snapshot. History (1966 Xerox (Bahamas) Ltd, 1968 Freeport, 1987 buyout) comes from an unverified TheOrg profile; 2002 merger confirmed by bahamasb2b/Tribune. '3,000+ customers' and leadership names (TheOrg) deliberately left off. Two emails exist: sales@bbsl.com (Xerox locator, used for form) and info@bbsl.com (own site, footer). Medium-size company with an existing site: pitch is a rebuild, budget likely higher end.
